# Candidate M — iteration_after_audit_1

Read `M-iteration_after_audit_1-CORRECTIVE_TASK.md` completely and execute it as the authoritative, bounded corrective task. Work in the existing M workspace, in a NEW Claude Code session, continuing from the CURRENT `output/template/` (the accepted iteration-4 result). Do not copy, reset, or regenerate from `baseline/template/` and do not use other candidates or previous ChatGPT audits as implementation sources.

The independent re-audit identified one root-cause defect in the current `.claude/scripts/check-manifests.mjs`: its XML attribute extraction and ProjectReference traversal recognize double-quoted attributes but can miss equivalent single-quoted valid XML. This permits a forbidden `Domain -> Api` reference, inline NuGet versions, or disallowed package IDs to go undetected, and can falsely report valid central `PackageVersion` entries as lacking Include/Version.

Repair the parser boundary comprehensively but narrowly. Attribute semantics must not depend on whether the value uses single or double quotes, attribute order, case where the existing contract is case-insensitive, accepted whitespace or multiline formatting. Both allowed and denied cases must be verified; do not merely make all inputs fail. Preserve the existing handling of XML comments and ordinary self-closing/paired elements. Do not add a new XML library, broad MSBuild interpreter, or a general-purpose shell/XML framework.

Authorized persistent changes: ONLY `output/template/.claude/scripts/check-manifests.mjs` and an appended `iteration_after_audit_1` section in the existing `output/REFINEMENT_REPORT.md`. Keep all other 60 template files byte-identical, preserving M identity, D1-D6 and all previously accepted hook, active-worktree, failed-command, npm, policy, reference, context, and hygiene invariants. `baseline/`, `source/`, `audit/`, and historical root files are immutable. Temporary tests must stay under `output/.work/` and be removed at the end.

Use ONE finite test harness against the actual checker in isolated fixtures. First reproduce the original bug on the unchanged checker. Then verify the full double/single/mixed quote matrix for ProjectReference, PackageReference, PackageVersion, Central Package Management, forbidden and permitted dependencies, denied/reviewed IDs, and relevant hook paths. For expected FAIL, require the correct substantive diagnostic, not an incidental setup error; for expected PASS, require zero violations and no unexpected notes. Include equivalence/metamorphic cases and preserved positive controls.

Run the focused suite and ONE final cumulative confirmation. Correct only demonstrated regressions and allow at most one bounded reconfirmation. Never begin a repeat audit-of-audit cycle. If a stop hook requests unsupported additional proof, record the specific reason and stop rather than rewriting evidence. Preserve truthful status: READY_TO_FREEZE only when all gates pass; otherwise BLOCKED with reproducible failing cases.

Append evidence, exact changed files, pre/post hashes, independently countable test totals, unchanged-file proof and documented limits to `output/REFINEMENT_REPORT.md`; ensure `output/` contains only `template/` and `REFINEMENT_REPORT.md`; STOP. Do not begin another iteration or pursue unrelated improvements.
